install: mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" && if ! "$HOME/.local/bin/filmcraft-cli" --version 2>/dev/null | grep -q '0.20.1'; then tmp=$(mktemp -d) && (gh release download v0.20.1 -R storytold/filmcraft -p filmcraft-0.20.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz -D "$tmp" --clobber || curl -fsSL -o "$tmp/filmcraft-0.20.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz" https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/releases/download/v0.20.1/filmcraft-0.20.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz) && tar -xzf "$tmp/filmcraft-0.20.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz" -C "$tmp" && cp -f "$(find "$tmp" -type f -name filmcraft-cli | head -n 1)" "$HOME/.local/bin/filmcraft-cli" && chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/filmcraft-cli" && rm -rf "$tmp"; fi && sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true && (grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc") && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && filmcraft-cli --version
